title: HyperSVG 2.0 host-profile document
description: What one host runs and grants, and its budgets: one document per host. Carries no about (2.5).
$comment: Generated by docs/spec-2.0-work/tools/schema/make-schemas.mjs from the spec/2.0 machine files. Do not edit.

capabilities.description: the capabilities this host runs, by name; absent: every capability the player has. A package that needs another is refused at mount (E-HOST-RUNS)

grants.description: in the shape of 10.5; anything not listed is denied

limits.description: how far this host lets content raise capacity limits; anything not listed stays at the format value

options.description: default options for the axes whose selector is host: axis id to option

requireSignature.description: whether a package must carry a valid signature (A9.3)

requireSignedReviews.description: whether admission uses signed reviews only (A9.3); default false

keys.description: keys the host trusts: a list of {id, by, alg, publicKey}; a signature's key names an id (A9.3)

retention.description: days to keep stored data (an integer, 1 or more; E-RANGE); data whose writtenAt is more days before the host's now is dropped before restore; absent means until cleared
